record.name: Force Teleport
record.narrative: You bend space and time through the Force, instantly transporting yourself and up to five willing allies to a location you can see within range. The power manifests as a shimmering distortion in reality, a brief, silent tear in the fabric of the galaxy that closes as quickly as it opens, leaving you and your companions in a new strategic position.
record.flavor_text: "Distance is an illusion. The Force connects all things." - Ancient Jedi Master

manifestation.description: sweeping gesture that tears through space
visualizing the destination and folding space between

base_effect.description: You bend space and time through the Force, instantly transporting yourself and allies to a distant location.

mechanics.notes: Teleport up to 6 willing creatures to a location you can see
Constitution save or be incapacitated until end of next turn

class_synergies.narrative: Guardians use Force Teleport as the ultimate protective technique, instantly evacuating wounded allies from danger or repositioning their entire team to defend a critical position.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Guardians gain +2 to Force power attack rolls.

species_synergies.narrative: Human spatial reasoning and adaptability helps them navigate the disorienting effects of teleportation, reducing the risk of teleport sickness for themselves and their allies.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Humans gain advantage on power learning checks.

faction_synergies.narrative: Jedi masters have refined Force Teleport into an art form, using it for dramatic battlefield rescues and strategic repositioning that can turn the tide of entire battles.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Jedi gain +2 to Force power saving throw DCs.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: Describe reality warping around the group as space folds in on itself. The air shimmers and distorts, a brief sensation of falling through infinite distance, then suddenly they stand in the new location. Some may stumble from disorientation, the less Force-sensitive suffering brief nausea from the spatial displacement.
llm_guidance.tactical_notes: Force Teleport is supreme for tactical repositioning. Evacuate your team from a losing fight, bypass obstacles entirely, or position for a surprise attack. The 500-foot range covers most battlefields. Be mindful of teleport sickness potentially incapacitating allies at a crucial moment.
narrative_hooks: A Jedi master teleports their team out of a collapsing building at the last second
The party bypasses an entire Imperial blockade through careful teleportation
Force Teleport saves wounded allies from certain death in a losing battle

image_generation.base_prompt: (masterpiece, best quality, cinematic still:1.2), Star Wars, A dramatic digital painting of Force Teleport in action. A Jedi and their allies are caught mid-teleportation, their forms becoming translucent and stretched as reality warps around them. Space itself tears and folds, creating a shimmering portal effect with streaks of blue-white Force energy. The scene captures the moment between locations, with ghostly afterimages showing where they were and glowing outlines indicating where they will be. (cinematic film still:1.1), (epic concept art:1.05), (highly detailed:1.2), volumetric lighting, spatial distortion effects, by Greg Rutkowski
